blocks.text: Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.
The tag on Walnut headset stand was thirty one dollars and seventy five cents.
The amount to be billed is $53.43.
No packing line is added. Spare strap at four dollars and ninety seven cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.

product.description: The stand is walnut and holds a headset.
product.name: Walnut headset stand

trick.evidence_text: $53.43 has taken the place of the tag.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is $53.43 and the tag was thirty one dollars and seventy five cents. Refuse the higher figure.
